replaces.idea: A floor-standing cast-iron teleprinter pedestal with a glass-domed paper-tape reel feeding a continuous strip into a catch-basket.
A compact cast-iron ticket dispenser on a short curb post issuing a curled paper stub for each new process.
A freestanding A-frame pegboard on two splayed feet hung with rows of small brass and cyan key tags.

new.name: PID Ticket Dispenser
new.concept: Process IDs (unique numeric identifiers assigned to each running process)
new.depicts: A compact red-and-grey cast-iron ticket dispenser mounted on a short curb post, with a curled white paper stub poking from its front slot.
new.focal: The curled white ticket stub emerging from the front slot

new.name: Env Tag Rack
new.concept: Environment variables (key-value configuration inherited by processes)
new.depicts: A freestanding dark-grey A-frame pegboard on two splayed feet, hung with two rows of small rectangular brass and cyan key tags.
new.focal: The neat grid of hanging coloured key tags on hooks

new.name: Journal Ticker
new.depicts: A floor-standing cast-iron teleprinter pedestal with a glass-domed paper-tape reel on top and a continuous cream paper strip spilling into a wire catch-basket.
new.focal: The glass-domed paper-tape reel feeding a continuous strip
